scene_description: Two pieces of white paper on a wooden table, each decorated with animal pictures made from real autumn leaves, berries, and seeds. The left paper shows a hedgehog and a butterfly made from colorful fall leaves and red berries. The right paper shows an owl and a bird made from brown leaves and seeds. Loose leaves, glue, and fruit are also on the table.

questions.question: What animals do you see made from leaves on the papers?
questions.sentence_frame: I see a ___ made from leaves.
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the shapes on the white papers — what animals can you spot?

questions.question: What are the leaves being used to make?
questions.sentence_frame: The leaves are being used to make ___.
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the white papers and see what shapes the leaves form.

questions.question: Where are the leaf animal pictures?
sample_answers: on white paper on the table
questions.evidence_hint: Look at where the leaf animals are sitting — what is underneath them?

questions.question: What is the glue bottle on the table used for?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the white bottle near the leaves — think about what glue does.

questions.question: What do you think the red berries are used for on the hedgehog picture?
sample_answers: to make dots on the hedgehog
questions.sentence_frame: I think the berries are used for ___.
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the left paper — where are the red berries placed on the hedgehog?

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever made a picture using leaves or nature things?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you did art with things from outside.
